Who I Am

About Me

I'm a Computer Science graduate from Ain Shams University and a data analyst with over a year of hands-on experience building analytics pipelines and BI dashboards. I take raw, messy data and turn it into clear, decision-driving insights — through clean SQL, well-engineered Python pipelines, and polished Power BI reports that stakeholders actually use.

My core stack covers the full analytics cycle: from data cleaning and modeling in SQL and Python, to KPI design and interactive dashboard delivery in Power BI and Excel. I'm comfortable with star schemas, DAX measures, ETL pipelines, and everything in between.

Currently expanding into Data Engineering — studying ETL/ELT architecture, Medallion data warehousing, dimensional modeling, and Informatica PowerCenter. My goal is to own the entire data journey from source to insight.
